2026 1.title: The Evening Mallard (Logo)
text: Used a pen tablet (those little slabs of plastic you plug into a computer) and Krita to make this one.
I first photoshopped a picture of a Mallard until it looked kinda like this, then I copied it and then drew a top hat on top.
Used pixlr to photoshop the duck, then to arrange the logo text.

2026 2.title: View from a Park
text: Made with watercolours on regular A4 print paper folded in half.
My first attempt at painting with watercolours. Not too shabby considering.

2026 3.title: J.M.W. Turner - Ariccia Sunset (Copy)
text: On today's episode of butchering artwork!

No, of course I had no expectations going in that I'd be able to match Turner's artwork. This is my first copy of a painting, and it was an interesting experience especially considering I don't really know what I'm doing.
I'm not familiar at all with painting; unlike, say, digital or pencil (where you can undo or erase mistakes), watercolour is much more unforgiving.
Also, yes, I copied an oil painting with watercolours, I'm aware.
I think the sky turned out pretty well though.
